urban_english_public.caution: Original study translation; not approved for liturgical use or recitation.
urban_english_public.text: O God, who rescue your Church, founded on the firmness of the apostolic rock, from the terror of the gates of hell: grant, we ask, that through the intercession of blessed Urban, your Martyr and Supreme Pontiff, she may be fortified with continual security, remaining steadfast in your strength. Through the Lord.
